deadline.value: Apply by December 1, 2026 for Fall 2027; later applications considered only if positions remain.
deadline.quote: December 1, 2026, is the final deadline for application materials to be submitted for Fall 2027 consideration

fee_waiver.value: The department has a fee-waiver application open only October 15-31, 2026 for qualified students; the BTAA waiver is domestic-only.
fee_waiver.quote: we offer a fee waiver (application opens on October 15th, 2026 and closes on October 31st, 2026 for FA27 consideration) that offsets the cost of our application for qualified students

gre_general.value: GRE is not required but may be submitted; no strict minimum.
gre_general.quote: GRE scores (general or subject) are not required, but applicants may submit them for consideration

gre_subject.value: Chemistry GRE Subject is not required but may be submitted.
gre_subject.quote: GRE scores (general or subject) are not required, but applicants may submit them for consideration

toefl_min.value: Department expects TOEFL iBT 100; an oral English evaluation by Zoom is also required before admission.
toefl_min.quote: For the internet-based test a score of 100

also.quote: the Department of Chemistry requires an oral evaluation of spoken English (via Zoom) with all applicants to our graduate program before admission.

english_waiver.value: TOEFL/IELTS required unless you earned a degree in a short list of English-speaking countries, and India is not on it.
english_waiver.quote: International applicants are required to submit TOEFL/IELTS scores in order to fulfill our English Proficiency Requirement. The only exception from this would be if you have previously completed a degree from an institution in one of the countries listed

supervisor.value: No advisor needed before applying; student-faculty pairing happens in Year 1.
supervisor.quote: No, student-faculty pairing happens during Year 1.

funding.value: Admitted students can expect a package with stipend, health insurance and full tuition scholarship.
funding.quote: Successful applicants can expect to receive a financial support package, which typically includes a stipend for living expenses, health insurance, and a full tuition scholarship.

entry_route.value: Not stated on the pages checked

notes: Fee waiver window is short and ends October 31, 2026.
